message:
Command `cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
import struct
PT_LOAD=1; PT_DYNAMIC=2; PT_GNU_STACK=0x6474e551
PF_R=4; PF_W=2; PF_X=1
ET_DYN=3; EM_X86_64=62
base=0x400000
phnum=2
phoff=64
phentsize=56
# dynamic offset just after ehdr+phdrs aligned 8
dynoff=64+phnum*56
assert dynoff%8==0
filesz=0x300
# ehdr
ident=b'\x7fELF'+bytes([2,1,1,0])+b'\0'*8
ehdr=struct.pack('<16sHHIQQQIHHHHHH', ident, ET_DYN, EM_X86_64, 1, base+0x100, phoff, 0, 0, 64, phentsize, phnum, 64, 0, 0)
# PT_LOAD covers entire file, align congruent
ph1=struct.pack('<IIQQQQQQ', PT_LOAD, PF_R|PF_X, 0, base, base, filesz, filesz, 0x1000)
# PT_DYNAMIC in load
ph2=struct.pack('<IIQQQQQQ', PT_DYNAMIC, PF_R|PF_W, dynoff, base+dynoff, base+dynoff, 0x40, 0x40, 8)
# dynamic entries: DT_STRSZ (10) valid less file_size, DT_NULL. no SYMTAB.
dyn=struct.pack('<QQ',10,0x20)+struct.pack('<QQ',0,0)+b'\0'*(0x40-32)
data=(ehdr+ph1+ph2+dyn).ljust(filesz,b'\0')
open('/workspace/poc_nosym_etdyn','wb').write(data)
print(len(data), dynoff)
PY
file /workspace/poc_nosym_etdyn && readelf -h -l -d /workspace/poc_nosym_etdyn | sed -n '1,180p'` executed with exit code 0.
